# Vendored browser dependencies

- `peerjs-1.5.4.min.js` is the unmodified PeerJS 1.5.4 browser build from
  `https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js`.
- SHA-256: `ad5d8870d1e389914f9cba8d35be313c4327c69ee0a221e482e9bf7621136fe5`.
- PeerJS is MIT licensed; see `PEERJS-LICENSE.txt`.

Keeping this file in the app means a CDN outage cannot disable multiplayer at
page load.
